# Native American Times

> A comprehensive news and lifestyle publication covering Native American communities, tribal governance, federal policy, and indigenous culture.

The Native American Times is a leading publication focused on news, politics, and cultural coverage affecting Native American tribes and communities. The publication operates out of Oklahoma and provides coverage spanning federal policy, tribal sovereignty, environmental issues, and indigenous lifestyle topics.

## Key Topics

- Native American news
- Tribal governance and sovereignty
- Federal Indian policy
- Indigenous rights
- Environmental protection
- Wildlife conservation
- Native American health
- Food sovereignty
- Indigenous entertainment
- Criminal justice in Indian Country
- Tribal elections
- BIA leadership
- Resource protection
- Oklahoma tribes
- Newspaper archives

## News & Politics

- [News](https://nativetimes.com/news): News hub: Federal, tribal, politics, crime, environment, wildlife
- [Federal](https://nativetimes.com/news/federal): Federal policy, BIA leadership, and tribal government news
- [Politics](https://nativetimes.com/news/politics): Native American politics, elections, and congressional representation
- [Tribal](https://nativetimes.com/news/tribal): Tribal sovereignty, governance, and indigenous rights coverage

## Environment & Wildlife

- [Environment](https://nativetimes.com/news/environment): Environmental law, pipelines, and tribal resource protection
- [Wildlife](https://nativetimes.com/news/wildlife): Wildlife conservation, bison management, and salmon protection

## Life & Culture

- [Life](https://nativetimes.com/life): Life section hub: entertainment, food, health, and culture
- [Entertainment](https://nativetimes.com/life/entertainment): Indigenous filmmaking, storytelling, and entertainment news
- [Food](https://nativetimes.com/life/food-21): Native American food, agriculture, and food sovereignty
- [Health](https://nativetimes.com/life/health): Native American health, mental health, and healthcare initiatives

## Justice & Legal

- [Crime](https://nativetimes.com/news/crime): Crime, legal cases, and criminal justice in Indian Country
